description:
*Any team wanting the chance to play in the Provincial SaskTel Tankard must register for playdowns by December 1st, 2026 @ 11:59pm Teams that qualify through Points do not play in the Last Chance. (Points cut off is December 1st @ 11:59pm)* **Last Chance December 17-20th, 2026**
**Provincials January 10-17, 2027** PAYMENT MUST BE RECEIVED PRIOR TO THE COMPETITION TO BE ELIGIBLE TO PLAY. OPTION 1: Pay now via credit card. CURLSASK will provide a full refund to all registered teams less $5/player administration fee should the event be cancelled. OPTION 2: Mail a cheque to CURLSASK, 613 Park St, Regina, SK S4N 5N1. Cheques will not be deposited until after the registration deadline. Should the event be cancelled, cheques will be destroyed. Select the CASH/CHEQUE option upon registering. OPTION 3: Pay via etransfer using the email curling@curlsask.ca, using the comment box to indicate which team the payment should be applied to. Select the CASH/CHEQUE option upon registering. CURLSASK will provide a full refund to all registered teams less $5/player administration fee should the event be cancelled.
name: 2027 SaskTel Tankard Playdowns - Tisdale
